expression_purity: author marker P/R/F1 and cohort Purity recomputed under both annotations
reference_concordance: mean-logcounts and gene-detection Pearson per type recomputed; unweighted type means explicitly named
neighbouring_contamination: B-to-T CD4/CD8A/CD8B curves recomputed using verified final-cell centroids
local_spatial_diversity: pinned author function recomputed with bin_width=500 um, R cut/ceiling bins, entropy 1.3.2, and log10 CV for transcript/gene/area values; unassigned retained as a category
replicability: Not measured across seeds or samples. Single seed1234/Rep1; spatial block bootstrap describes this slide, not training-seed uncertainty.
spatial_extension: Four new methods and B1 control recomputed by unchanged pinned author R wrapper/function.

paired_extension.new2: Full own matrices/QC/scClassify/six metrics, full native geometry, own reference correlations and neighboring curves, author spatial diversity; formal15stage complete-check passed

boundary_extension: Eight new unique endpoints: own final mask/matrix, ownQC, both raw six metrics/finite denominators, reference correlations, author spatial diversity, fixed-ID strata/owners and spatial bootstrap. Independent analysis and root raw reductions linked in complete.json.

current_assessment_policy.current_assessment: Parallel fixed-label and scClassify positive/negative F1; highlight either profile standout and conflicts, with original populations. No post-hoc scalar winner score.
current_assessment_policy.paper_reference: B0 explicitly included for all BASE_MATCH-related contrasts; may serve as paper principal reference.
current_assessment_policy.mechanistic_control: Retain BASE_MATCH and A2 GT/SHUFFLED controlled contrasts; B0 has unmatched training initialization/history/order.
current_assessment_policy.frozen_gate: Original sc-primary/fixed-auxiliary software decisions are immutable historical calculations, not silently relabeled as dual-profile gates.
current_assessment_policy.evaluations: Reuse verified actual existing scores; no mask, expression matrix, annotation, reference model, NA rule or scientific thresholds changed.

replication: Single specimen/seed; spatial intervals conditional within slide, not training/specimen replication or true owner accuracy.
